briefing: Stocks rose today, with the NASDAQ up 1.2% and the S&P 500 up 0.8%, led again by semiconductor and AI hardware names. We hold 7 positions, the portfolio is up 47.9%, and cash is $445.88. That is below the $500 minimum for a new buy, so we are not opening anything new today. We are keeping all current positions and letting the automatic profit targets and stop-losses decide the exits. NBIS, AXTI and BE are the top candidates for when cash frees up.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder is the cash an investor keeps on hand so they can buy when a good opportunity comes along. Today the market was strong and many stocks looked attractive, but our cash was just under the $500 minimum, so we could not make a sensible new purchase. It shows that being fully invested has a cost: when good setups appear, you need cash available or you have to sell something to make room.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」指投資者手上預留的現金，方便在好機會出現時買入。今日市況強勁，不少股份都有吸引力，但我們的現金略低於500美元的下限，未能合理地開新倉。這說明資金全數投入是有代價的：好機會出現時，手上要有現金，否則就要先賣出其他持倉騰出資金。

market_education.summary_en: Stocks rose today, led by technology: the NASDAQ gained 1.2% and the S&P 500 gained 0.8%. Chipmakers and AI hardware companies such as MU, AMD, LITE, SNDK and MRVL did best. Many of them traded at unusually high volume and closed above their 20-day averages, a sign that big investors were buying rather than a brief intraday spike. No news headlines came with today's data, so this explanation rests only on price and volume, not on any specific news story.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日美股造好，由科技股領漲，納斯達克升1.2%，標普500升0.8%。晶片及AI硬件股表現最強，包括MU、AMD、LITE、SNDK及MRVL。多隻股份成交量明顯高於平日，並收於20日平均線之上，反映大型資金正在買入，而非盤中短暫炒高。由於今日數據未附新聞標題，以上分析只根據股價及成交量，並無引用特定新聞。
